source.title: [re:DEFINICIJA] Zlatko Krznarić: Fatalna nesreća bila je moj novi početak (ep. 9)

summary.title_hr: [re:DEFINICIJA] Zlatko Krznarić: Fatalna nesreća bila je moj novi početak (ep. 9)
summary.abstract_hr: U 9. epizodi podcasta Redefinicija gost je Zlatko Krznarić, katolički suprug, otac petero djece i vozač po zanimanju, koji studira teologiju kako bi postao trajni đakon. Opisuje svoj život prije obraćenja, ispovijed nakon koje se vratio vjeri te ponovni susret sa suprugom Sandrom, s kojom je u čistoći hodao tri godine prije braka. Govori o 2011. godini, kada je nakon prijevare pri ulaganju u nekretnine i stečaja doživio prometnu nesreću u kojoj mu je amputirana lijeva noga, te o tome kako je u bolničkoj kapelici predao život Bogu. Pripovijeda o nastanku knjige Ti si svjedok i o tome kako je, unatoč otporu, prihvatio poziv na trajni đakonat. Iznosi i niz iskustava s hodočašća biciklom u Međugorje i sa studija koja tumači kao znakove Božje providnosti.
key_points: Zlatko je 1993., u 21. godini, odbacio Boga i živio svjetovno, ali je osjećao prazninu. Nakon jednosatne ispovijedi kod fra Ante Barišića vratio se vjeri i nakon toga ponovno počeo hodati sa Sandrom, s kojom se oženio 1998.

Godine 2011. prevaren je pri ulaganju u nekretnine i završio u stečaju, a dva do tri tjedna kasnije u prometnoj nesreći amputirana mu je lijeva noga. U bolnici mu je supruga rekla da je trudna s petim djetetom, Leom, i da će ga roditi bez obzira na siromaštvo.

Bolnički kapelan, velečasni Milan Lončarić, rekao mu je da ga Bog zove da mu preda život te da će pisati i svjedočiti. Zlatko je nakon toga u bolničkoj kapelici predao život Bogu. Prema njegovim riječima, obitelj je uz Božju pomoć vratila sve dugove.
Knjiga Ti si svjedok izašla je 2017. U njoj je iskreno opisao svoje slabosti, a dosad je imala četiri izdanja i prijevod.

Poziv na trajni đakonat dugo je odbijao jer se smatrao nesposobnim za fakultet. Nakon hodočašća biciklom od Čakovca do Međugorja, razgovora sa svećenicima i susreta s biskupom Božom Radošem upisao je studij na Jordanovcu.
Sada je na četvrtoj godini studija, nakon kojeg slijede još tri godine đakonske formacije. Objasnio je da đakon može obavljati sve osim pretvorbe, ispovijedi i bolesničkog pomazanja.
Onima koji razmišljaju o pozivu poručuje da Bog ne gleda zanimanje ni obrazovanje, nego srce i vjernost, te da je čovjek to upotrebljiviji za Boga što je spremniji na žrtvu.
key_points_en: In 1993, at the age of 21, Zlatko rejected God and lived worldly, but felt an emptiness. After an hour-long confession with fra Ante Barišić, he returned to faith and after that began dating Sandra again, whom he married in 1998.

In 2011, he was defrauded in a real estate investment and ended up in bankruptcy, and two to three weeks later his left leg was amputated in a traffic accident. In the hospital, his wife told him that she was pregnant with their fifth child, Leo, and that she would give birth to him regardless of poverty.

The hospital chaplain, Father Milan Lončarić, told him that God was calling him to surrender his life to Him and that he would write and witness. After that, Zlatko surrendered his life to God in the hospital chapel. According to his words, the family repaid all debts with God's help.
The book Ti si svjedok came out in 2017. In it, he honestly described his weaknesses, and so far it has had four editions and a translation.

He refused the call to the permanent diaconate for a long time because he considered himself incapable of college. After a bicycle pilgrimage from Čakovec to Međugorje, conversations with priests, and a meeting with Bishop Bože Radoš, he enrolled in studies at Jordanovac.

He is now in his fourth year of study, followed by another three years of diaconal formation. He explained that a deacon can perform everything except the consecration, confession, and the anointing of the sick.

To those considering a vocation, he conveys that God does not look at occupation or education, but at the heart and faithfulness, and that a person is all the more useful to God the more ready they are for sacrifice.
summary.title_en: [re:DEFINICIJA] Zlatko Krznarić: A Fatal Accident Was My New Beginning (ep. 9)
summary.abstract_en: In the 9th episode of the Redefinicija podcast, the guest is Zlatko Krznarić, a Catholic husband, father of five children, and a driver by profession, who is studying theology in order to become a permanent deacon. He describes his life before conversion, the confession after which he returned to faith, and his reunion with his wife Sandra, with whom he dated in purity for three years before marriage. He speaks about the year 2011, when, after a real estate investment fraud and bankruptcy, he suffered a traffic accident in which his left leg was amputated, and about how he surrendered his life to God in the hospital chapel. He recounts the creation of the book Ti si svjedok and how, despite resistance, he accepted the call to the permanent diaconate. He also shares a series of experiences from a bicycle pilgrimage to Međugorje and from his studies, which he interprets as signs of God's providence.
